controls.requirement: Supported iOS versions, devices, orientations, accessibility modes, and upgrade paths are explicit and tested.

Unit, UI, launch, crash, memory, energy, frame-time, poor-network, offline, and background/foreground behavior meet budgets; native proof includes CI-attested xcodebuild test evidence from a commissioned macOS simulator or physical-device destination bound to the release build identity.
Entitlements, Keychain, ATS, privacy manifests, permissions, deep links, universal links, and local data protection are reviewed.

An approved macOS/Xcode runner produces a signed archive with source, dependency, signing-identity, and build provenance; proof requires CI-attested xcodebuild archive command evidence with runnerOs=macos plus a GitHub Actions/Xcode Cloud provider receipt.

TestFlight/App Store upload, beta review, tester access, phased release, version compatibility, and rollback/disable paths are approval-gated when distribution is in scope; proof requires an Apple-hosted App Store Connect/TestFlight provider report plus exact-scope human release approval bound to a token-gated bridge event.
APNs credentials, notification authorization, payload privacy, invalid-token cleanup, rate behavior, and delivery fallback are tested when push is used.
